text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(I reached it... Somehow...! The Spring 
Shield I've yearned for so long...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(For some reason... it felt so far away. 
But right now...!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Everyone, thank you so very much...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still... I don't have any strength left... 
U-Ughhh...

—Joy. But even more than that, a deep, 
palpable fatigue was clearly visible.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(It's really taking a toll... on my legs, 
too... 3,200 meters is no walk in the 
park. But...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(The primary reason I'm this exhausted 
is...)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Well, well! Splendidly done, Top Road-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You're the real deal after all. I couldn't 
be happier!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I want to run with the wonderful you once 
more. Yes—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right this instant! My body, my very soul, 
cries out for another battle with you...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right... now...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(This resilience is... definitely strange. 
Even Opera O must have given it everything 
she had...)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
(And yet... isn't she tired? Or... has she 
already recovered?)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Please, don't look so appalled. I'm only 
joking about 'right this second.' But 
still—"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, the win is mine, Top Road-san. 
And once I pass you..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I won't let you pass me again. No matter 
how many times we run, for all eternity.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
In this second act—you and I shall 
continue dancing the very same dance 
forever.

From a distance, it was impossible to tell 
what they were talking about. What caught 
my eye, however, was—

Despite having won, Narita Top Road looked 
completely terrified.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ouch...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's nothing serious. My legs always 
act up a bit in the spring anyway.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Plus, Opera O-chan's pressure was 
unbelievable the whole time today.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Watching today's race, what did you think 
of Opera O-chan, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Without a doubt... a monster.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: You thought so too, didn't you, Trainer?

"Even from a Trainer's perspective, there 
was no doubt about it. It was unthinkable 
that she could run 3,200 meters and act 
like nothing happened."

Truly the End-of-Century Overlord. And to 
think, if she's going to get even stronger 
from here on out...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If someone doesn't put a stop to this 
soon, it's going to get completely out of 
hand...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
At middle distance, we might be able to 
stop her. If we can drag it into a contest 
of instant burst acceleration.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Next—I will go. Opera O is certain to 
enter the next GⅠ, the Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Because Opera... is a threat to me as 
well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...There's no way. Anyone who could see 
that potential today and still feel 
confident would be nothing more than a 
fool.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Giving up, however, would be even more 
foolish. Even if I am beaten to the 
ground...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san, Trainer-san. I want to run in 
the Takarazuka Kinen too...!

There is little time left until the 
Takarazuka Kinen, the medium-distance GⅠ 
that concludes the spring.
choice_data_list:
With how tired you are today, you should 
get some rest...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
As long as you're here with me, Trainer, 
I'll be fine. We've overcome everything so 
far, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's true that Opera O-chan is strong and 
intimidating... But...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"Not facing it is even scarier. If I run 
away just because I'm scared..."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm falling further and 
further behind her. So, I have to do 
something here and now!

A single arrow stands no chance. But with 
two, the odds of winning increase. 
Normally, that's how it goes, but—

This time, I really don't think that's the 
case. It's very possible we both end up 
getting defeated in turn.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I have to find a way to face this somehow. 
But...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It's not that simple.

Even Narita Top Road, who is usually the 
first to voice her motivation, falls 
silent...

"Somehow, we have to find a breakthrough 
before the Takarazuka Kinen. Before our 
opponent becomes a true Demon King."
